resources.string: Tap “Open Room” or “Find Rooms” to chat.
This device has no Bluetooth. Use a device with Bluetooth to chat.
Allow access to “Nearby devices” to connect the devices over Bluetooth.
Allow location access while using the app to find nearby rooms.
Bluetooth is off. Turn it on in your device settings.
Turn on Bluetooth and keep it on to send and receive messages.
Could not open the room to receive connections. Check that Bluetooth is on and try again.
Could not connect to %1$s. Keep Chat de Rua open on both devices, keep them close, and try again.
Could not connect to %1$s. Keep Bluetooth on and Chat de Rua open on both devices, then try again.
The connection ended. Use “Open Room” or “Find Rooms” to reconnect and continue chatting.
The connection was lost. Keep the devices close with Bluetooth on, and reconnect to continue.
You disconnected the devices. Reconnect to send and receive messages.
How would you like to find a room?
Opening a room automatically. Please wait…
Automatic opening is paused for 1 hour. To resume now, tap “Open a room automatically”.
You canceled automatic room opening. Would you like to look for an open room on another device?
For 1 hour, the app will not open rooms on its own. You can still open a room whenever you want.
Messages will be deleted only from this device, and any audio or music playing will stop. Your sticker collection will be kept.
Please wait and confirm the Android request so other devices can find your room.
Preparing your room so other devices can find it…
Could not set the room name in Bluetooth. Check that Bluetooth is on and try opening the room again.
Room available for %1$d seconds. Waiting for a connection…
The time to find this room has expired. The app will try opening it again when automatic opening is allowed.
Could not make the room available. Try opening it again and confirm the Android request.
Allow other devices to find your room over Bluetooth, then try opening the room again.
Could not find rooms. Check that Bluetooth is on and tap “Find Rooms” to try again.
Turn on location in your device settings to find nearby rooms.
Could not open settings. Open your device settings, turn on location, and return to the app.
No devices found. On the other device, open Chat de Rua and tap “Open Room”. Then search again.
On the other device, open Chat de Rua, tap “Open Room”, and confirm the Android request. Keep the devices close with Bluetooth on and search again.
Looking for nearby devices and paired Bluetooth devices. This may take a few seconds.
On this device, Android needs location turned on to find other Bluetooth devices. Turn on location and return to the app to find rooms.
The room is already opening or waiting for someone to connect. You do not need to open it again.
Cancel opening your room before looking for another room.
Optional. If you enter “Ana”, others will see your room as “Room - Ana”.
Choose a shorter name without line breaks.
Open Bluetooth settings, choose the other device, and confirm the code on both devices. Then return to Chat de Rua and choose the paired device.
%1$s wants to connect over Bluetooth. Check and confirm the code on the Android screen.
Check that the code matches on both devices and confirm the Android request.
Could not pair %1$s over Bluetooth. Try again and confirm the request on both devices.
Could not pair the device over Bluetooth. Try using Bluetooth settings.
To connect to %1$s for the first time, confirm the Android request on both devices.
The time to accept has expired. Ask the other person to try connecting again.
%1$s wants to chat with you. Accept only if you recognize the device and want to start chatting.
The connection was declined. Reconnect the devices to chat. Entry to the room must be accepted.
Use the same password on both devices to read messages. The password you enter is neither saved nor sent to the other person.
The default password is the same for everyone using the app. For more privacy, turn off this option and agree on a different password with the other person.
Received messages appear when the password matches on both devices.
The password must contain at least 12 letters, numbers, or symbols.
The messages in this chat have been removed from your device.
Protected message. Check that the password matches on both devices.
Turn on Bluetooth and grant the requested permissions to connect the devices.
Tap “Disconnect” before connecting to another device.
Please wait. The app is already trying to connect.
Open Bluetooth settings, choose the other device, and confirm the code on both devices. Then return to Chat de Rua to connect.
Your message is too long. Shorten it and try again.
Connect to another device before sending messages or files.
Tap “Open Room” to receive a connection or “Find Rooms” to join another room. Wait for the connection before sending messages.
The message could not be prepared for sending. It was not sent. Try again.
Could not send the message. Check the connection and try again.
You can cancel. Canceling during transmission will end the connection.
Choose a smaller image. The limit is 50 MB for the selected file and 10 MB after the app adjusts it.
Could not open this image. Choose another image and try again.
Could not send the image. Select it again to retry.
Could not prepare the image for sending. It was not sent. Try again.
Received image. Tap to open full screen.
The image will be removed only from this chat on your device. Saved copies and the image on the other device will not be deleted.
Image saved to the selected location.
Could not save the image. Try again and choose another folder.
Allow microphone access in the app settings to record audio.
Could not start recording. Check microphone permission and try again.
Could not use this recording. Record again for a few seconds before sending.
The audio is too large to send. Record a shorter clip, up to 10 MB.
Could not send the audio. Check the connection and record it again.
Could not prepare the audio for sending. It was not sent. Record again to retry.
Could not play this audio. Try again.
Record up to 5 minutes. When the time or file size limit is reached, recording stops and the audio is sent. The recording is not saved to the gallery.
You can cancel. Canceling during transmission will end the connection.
Choose a smaller MP3 file, up to 10 MB.
Could not open this file as MP3. Choose another MP3 file.
Could not send the MP3. Check the connection and select the file again to retry.
Could not prepare the MP3 for sending. It was not sent. Select the file again to retry.
Preparing the MP3 for playback in the chat…
Stickers are saved in this app. Tap one to view, send, or delete it. Clearing the chat does not delete your collection.
You have no saved stickers yet. Tap “Create” to turn an image or short video into a sticker.
Short video (up to 6 seconds, no sound)
Choose a file up to 50 MB. Videos and animations must be no longer than 6 seconds. The app resizes the sticker, which can be up to 4 MB. Video stickers have no sound.
Choose an animation or video no longer than 6 seconds.
Choose a smaller file. The limit is 50 MB for the selected file and 4 MB for the created sticker.
Could not use this file. Choose another image, an animated GIF/WebP, or a video up to 6 seconds long.
Could not open the file picker. Check that a file manager app is installed on your device.
Still sticker. Tap to view or save to your collection.
Animated sticker. Tap to view or save to your collection.
The sticker will be deleted only from your collection. It will remain in chats where it has already been sent.
Could not save the sticker. Check that your device has free storage space and try again.
Could not open this sticker. Try again or create a new one.
Wait for the current send, recording, or creation to finish.
Could not send the sticker. It is still available in your collection.
